body:

CERTIFICATION (three layers, 0348 process rule: no formal module before the seam audit passes): (1) ENVIRONMENT REPEAT - established (CE2 header); (2) PIPELINE RUN: code/window.py on a = 12 363 155 097 114 (= b82), b requested = b actual = 12 363 155 117 114, M = 60, C_R = 1, 32 workers, 34 168 evaluations, 2 571.1 s, resumed_from_cache = 571 877 (seeded from window82_b82.json.cache.jsonl - the EIGHTEENTH overlap run; wall-time series 2 571.1 s, stable in the 2 500-2 650 s band). NON-SNAPPED - the full requested width was a good Gram point at working precision; certified width b - a = 20 000. (3) VERIFIER (code/verify_window.py on window83_b83.json, log verify83.log): CERTIFIED: true, turing_ok: true, points_checked = 34 168, sign_changes_inside = 20 000 (= b - a, full width), roser_failures_inside = 2, roser_run_left_of_a = 48, roser_run_right_of_b = 36 (both >= K_conservative = 12), max_phase_contribution_4sqrtN_rad_theta = [4.10e-21, radius 2.61e-24], 0 hypothesis/path failures, 0 cross-check failures (all 34 168 records), 0 undetermined Gram signs, 0 gram-point mismatches, endpoints recomputed and matched. The third-recorded block past b is a new series first: a recorded Rosser exception OUTSIDE the certified window's Gram interior (the run evaluates slightly past b; the verifier's interior count is 2). All three quota-met on their unions; no conclusion changes.

ENDPOINT DECODE: g_b83 = [116063676727106314429975903822503861247, -85, 16777217, -110] (exact dyadic tuple authoritative): 3 000 175 725 321.3869823959479319585248033499338895828268260028426350771724173682741820812225341796875 + or - 1.29e-26 (radius 16777217 x 2^-110). The endpoint ball STAYS normalized at exponent -85 (sequence: -86 ..g_b78, -85 g_b79, -84 g_b80, -85 g_b81, -85 g_b82, -85 g_b83). DECODE-CONVENTION NOTE (verified re-derivation, recorded for the ledger): the displayed endpoint decimals are the CENTER readings mm x 2^-85 (the ball is center +/- radius); the series' quoted margins are the conservative center-minus-radius readings in integer-tuple arithmetic - both conventions re-derived exactly for W83 against the CE82 record before writing (the CE82 MARG82 string reproduces bit-for-bit). The floor tCE83 = 3 000 175 725 321 sits 0.38698239594793... (center reading) above the integer boundary - robust by many orders of magnitude. The standard two-decimal lower bound gB83Lo = 3 000 175 725 321.38 has the exact conservative margin 0.00698239594793195852480333700919174... (integer-tuple arithmetic) - THIN (fourth case: W79 1.76e-4, W81 4.03e-4, W82 1.87e-3, W83 6.98e-3); cent-granularity luck of the endpoint, not a precision danger (radius eight orders smaller); no pattern claimed on thin margins. PROCESS NOTE (two bugs caught by the build, recorded for the ledger): (a) the CE83 generator RE-emitted the header doc comment with the wrong opener - slash-STAR-bang ('/*!') instead of the CE-series convention slash-DASH-bang ('/-!') - the SECOND occurrence of this recurrence (first in the CE82 cycle); fixed to slash-dash-bang, rebuilt green; the generator hygiene asserts now must check the opener (and closer) before the build is allowed to catch it. (b) NEW LOCUS: the header text contained '+/-' (in the arb max-phase-contribution string), and the slash-DASH inside '+/-' LEXES AS A NESTED COMMENT OPENER in Lean (Lean comments nest), leaving an unterminated comment at EOF ('unterminated comment' at line 694). Fix: rephrased to '[4.10e-21, radius 2.61e-24]'. LESSON: header text must avoid the two-character sequence slash-DASH anywhere (including inside '+/-'); the doc-sweep should scan for it.

TALLY THROUGH WINDOW 83: 83 windows - 36 clean, 47 rescue; 70 total internal Rosser failures, ALL RECORDED (W83 adds two interior; its third block sits past b, outside the interior count).
